item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting, with no frame or surrounding setting. Build a dense, turbulent center from layered cobalt, ultramarine, and deep violet, crossed by sharp passages of vermilion, hot coral, and pale gold. Use forceful, broken brush gestures, scraped pigment, dry-brush grain, translucent washes, and granular flecks to create shifts between compression and release. Let the color fields surge, interrupt, and overlap in uneven rhythms, with strong contrast and pockets of near-black depth. Leave a few quiet areas of raw, warm white around the edges and within the composition to create spatial tension and breathing room. Keep every mark purely abstract; include no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text."}
